record_type_quote: Our analysis should be classified as a computational reproduction. The data provided was (re-)coded, cleaned and the replication was conducted based on the procedures described in the paper rather than the replication do-files provided by Settele (2022). We include a minor robustness replicability with an alternative specification to measure the treatment effect by comparing the both treatment groups to the pure control group rather than a between-treatment comparison.

targets.title: How do beliefs about the gender wage gap affect the demand for public policy?
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted a computational replication of Settele (2022), with a re-coding of the original data.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: Following an adjustment of the working directory in the master do file the code runs and delivers the reported point estimates.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: In addition, we introduce a slightly different index measure and find that the results and patterns identified replicate in this slightly different data context.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original code recovered reported estimates; independent recoding and an alternative index preserved substantive findings. Small numerical differences are treated as negligible by authors.

reasoning: Reanalysis of original survey data, not new data. One target paper; other references supply methods.
